description: Land Acquisition - Madduvil Naadu, Poonakary D/S Division, Kilinochchi District - Gampolawela, Ganga Ihala Korale D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purposes (construction of a switchyard access road under a hydro power project). It contains detailed descriptions of the lands to be acquired, including lot numbers, claimant information, extents, and boundaries. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
